Wrangler Air box

64 × 80 × 35 mm. DinMeter in the top face, screen up. Relay flat on the floor, ADC on its edge against the front wall. Car wires enter through a slot low in the left wall, tied to the anchor. Cover taped to the tunnel wall, the body clicks onto it. Hover or tap a part for its name.
+12 V AUX1 (red 1.5) / COM+12 V to DinMeter (orange 0.25) GND (black)GND to DinMeter (blue 0.25) relay NO to K2 86 via D1sensor cable sensor SIG to ADC INGrove: PORT.A to ADC, PORT.B to relay
